text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Just like the sky above Kyoto Racecourse 
today! Today's racecourse is beneath a 
brilliant blue sky!”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I won—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Seiun Sky?! To think she 
took down an even stronger Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...! A race like this really 
exists...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers, applause, and stirring murmurs. 
Everyone in the venue was made painfully 
aware— that Seiun Sky was the true 
protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... Ahaha...! This is it, this is 
what I was looking for!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This is it. This is what I've... been 
searching for...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah... Best feeling ever...♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Congratulations. You were so strong!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad... I got to run the Classic 
Triple Crown races with you, Sei-chan! 
Congratulations, truly!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still—I won't lose again!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Your declaration of war has duly 
been accepted.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Let's run together again, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Rivals who gave their all across the 
Classics praise one another. The venue 
erupts into even greater excitement at the 
beautiful sight... and the 'Kikuka Sho' 
comes to a glorious close."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on! It's the triumphant return of the 
Kikuka Sho Umamusume! Hype it up, hype it 
up, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hello, hello~. It's the 'strong 
Umamusume', Sei-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, to be honest I thought it'd be 
tough~, but somehow or another! We pulled 
off the win.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your own ability.
It's all thanks to your own ability.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Guess so~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding. But hey, did you see 
Spe-chan's face?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's like she's saying, "I'm not going 
down here!" Good grief, looks like she's 
gonna give me a hard time again~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky wryly smiled as he spoke, 
looking like he was secretly having fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on the way back from the race—Seiun 
Sky was surrounded by a crowd of fans.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Seiun Sky! Today's race was 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the Arima Kinen 
too~! Good luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen? Am I... running in it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The year-end Grand Prix race, the Arima 
Kinen. While it's a goal for many 
Umamusume, Seiun Sky hasn't decided on her 
next race yet.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you won the Kikuka Sho, so I just 
assumed you were going...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Keep up this momentum, beat Grass Wonder, 
and prove you're the strongest of our 
generation!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh~, so Grass-chan plans to enter.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I see... 'Strongest of our generation,' 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, with that in mind, shall we go ahead 
and enter the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"My schedule after this was totally clear 
anyway, so I figured it'd be just right~"
choice_data_list:
It's a tough lineup, but are you going to 
be okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, are you really saying that now? 
Even though we were aiming for the Triple 
Crown together♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, it'll work out somehow! We've always 
managed to pull through before, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I have a feeling there's still plenty 
of fun to be had♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, spurred on by the fans' 
expectations, our next goal was set as the 
Arima Kinen.
